nodes.title: Operators needed a source-neutral portfolio read surface without moving portfolio authority into Factory Floor
nodes.description: The existing operator packages covered Factory Floor runtime state. A separate read-only client was needed to display Portfolio Control Plane projections while preserving their source-neutral and opaque semantics.

nodes.title: Consume Portfolio Control Plane through a separate bounded read-only client
nodes.description: The client exposes bounded GET operations, preserves opaque projection records, and provides no claim, outcome, reconciliation, execution, or owner-decision mutation method.

nodes.title: Add the portfolio client, reusable React view, and optional standalone route
nodes.description: Factory Floor added a separate client export and read-only Portfolio view. The standalone console enables it only when a Portfolio Control Plane URL is configured.

nodes.title: Factory Floor can present portfolio projections without owning portfolio intent
nodes.description: The Portfolio Control Plane remains authoritative for source-neutral coordination projections. Factory Floor remains authoritative for its own runtime and event state. This commit establishes a tested read surface, not a universal portfolio-to-execution integration.

edges.rationale: Reusable run-scoped operator packages created the boundary where another authority's read model could be presented without sharing state ownership.
The authority boundary required a separate client with read-only methods and opaque responses.
The bounded client decision was implemented in reusable client, view, and console packages.
The tested read-only surface preserves the distinction between presentation and portfolio authority.
